OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as the scene settings below describe; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Her source may add one small accent at most — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.
